hero.headline: What's New, inside the app
hero.sub: Release notes stopped being a changelog you were expected to go and find. Every update is a page in the dashboard, and the app tells you when there's a new one.

shot.alt: The Announcements page in the dashboard: the newest story as a hero card with its cover screenshot, older stories listed underneath
shot.caption: The feed: newest story up top, everything before it one click away.

items.title: The page
items.text: Announcements in the sidebar footer: the newest story as a hero, the rest as a compact archive you can page through.

items.title: The popup
items.text: On the launch after something ships, the newest story comes to you once. Being shown it counts as read, so it never nags twice.

items.title: The badge
items.text: Unread is tracked per story id, not by a watermark — a story added out of order still shows up as new.

blocks.title: Opened full screen, read like a page
blocks.body: Click any story and it fills the viewport: hero, screenshots, the proof, and Newer / Older controls to move through the feed without going back to the list. Any screenshot can be clicked to fill the screen when the detail matters.

shot.alt: An announcement open in the full-screen reader, showing the hero headline, its screenshot and the newer/older pager

blocks.text: The format has since changed under it: these pages were originally drawn as diagram boards, and as of 0.22 they are built from real screenshots of the app instead. Same feed, same ids — better evidence.
